text: おれの　やった　＊　イイだろ？

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A short phrase ending in a verb, put right before a thing, tells you which thing it is. Inside such a phrase の can stand in for が to show who did it. おれの　やった　＊ = 'the ＊ that I gave'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ at the end asks the listener to agree: 'right?'. It is the clipped, rough form of だろう. イイだろ = 'it's great, isn't it?'.
